title: Case Studies of Real AI Systems — Look Beyond the Architecture Diagram

body:
## Look Beyond the Architecture Diagram

A case study praises an impressive model but never states the user problem or whether outcomes improved. The picture cannot teach the decision.

Start with context: users, job, scale, constraints, and success criteria. Then trace the system route and the evidence for its results.

Separate reported fact from your inference. Public case studies often omit costs, failures, and internal alternatives.
common_mistakes: An architecture diagram proves business success.
A famous design should be copied regardless of workload.
A postmortem is complete after blaming one operator.
mini_exercise: Draw “Look Beyond the Architecture Diagram” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: Real systems show how model choices interact with users, data, organizations, and operations.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Look Beyond the Architecture Diagram,” explain Case Studies of Real AI Systems without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
